verdict.rationale: Apify Store offers 64,279 ready-made Actors (marketplace scrapers) that can be run directly via API/client without building from scratch, e.g. calling 'apify/web-scraper' with just input params, and docs explicitly note users can run both their own Actors and Store Actors. Specific pre-built scrapers like TikTok extractor further evidence ready-to-use tools, and community testimonials corroborate real-world usage. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically confirming a marketplace-run workflow (vs. building) and quality/reliability benchmarking across marketplace Actors.
